name: Umi o Hamu
source:
Dinei is a small island nation far from the continent.
The protagonist is entrusted by the government to manage a temple as the guardian of "Fadam", an ancient belief in Dinei.

Far from such a grand title, her days are muddled and mundane, but then she is instructed that one of the responsibilities of the temple's administrator is to provide "health guidance" to its employees....

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23337]Freem![/url]]
translation:
迪内伊是一个远离大陆的小岛国。
主角受政府委托，作为迪内伊古老信仰“法达姆”的守护者，管理一座寺庙。

与如此宏伟的头衔相去甚远，她的日子过得很混乱、平凡，但后来她接到指示，寺庙管理员的职责之一就是为员工提供“健康指导”……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/23337]Freem![/url]]
